summary:
Frontend-only verification of Chaser rebrand + invitation email + realtime + rename business. RESULTS: (1) REBRAND PASS — login screen title 'Chaser' + tagline 'Behind every good operation'; migration button 'Continue to Chaser'; Home header shows 'Chaser' with italic tagline; More footer 'Chaser · Behind every good operation · v1.0'. No visible 'HectareHQ' string leaked in AuthScreen, MigrationScreen, Home, or More. (2) INVITATION EMAIL PASS — POST /api/invitations/{id}/send-email returned 200 with email_id (msg=42a454b7...); backend log 'Sent invitation email to jake.comley@hotmail.com for business e24331bd-...' confirmed in /var/log/supervisor/backend.err.log. UI showed 'Invitation sent to jake.comley@hotmail.com as operator...' notice and pending invite row. (3) INVITATION RESEND PASS — Second /send-email call returned 200 with a NEW msg id (ebcf2c1d-...); UI notice 'Invitation to jake.comley@hotmail.com refreshed.' displayed. (4) REALTIME PASS — Two pages in same context both on /team; invite sent from tab A propagated to tab B pending list in ~1.5s without manual refresh (useRealtime subscription on member_invitations table). (5) RENAME BUSINESS PASS — pencil icon visible for owner only; edit → save updated Account card name inline to 'Chaser Test Farm Renamed'; Team header immediately reflected the new name; after navigating away and back the renamed value persisted (Supabase businesses.name update). (6) RENAME PERMISSION VERIFIED VIA CODE — /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/more.tsx:89 gates pencil on `business?.role === 'owner'` and auth-context.tsx:228 rejects rename attempts from non-owner clients server-side via RLS. 

FIX APPLIED: /app/frontend/app/team.tsx was missing `import { useRealtime } from '@/src/lib/realtime'` while using it at line 38 — this would have caused a runtime ReferenceError on every mount of /team. Added the import. Verified /team renders cleanly and realtime subscription works end-to-end after the fix. 

RESIDUAL 'HectareHQ' OCCURRENCES (report only, not blocking any tested flow):
  a) /app/frontend/src/lib/csv.ts:49 — exported CSV filename is `hectarehq-spray-records-YYYY-MM-DD.csv` (user-visible on download).
  b) /app/frontend/app/records/[id].tsx: Share summary literal begins with 'HectareHQ Spray Record' (user-visible when sharing a completed record).
  c) /app/frontend/app/records/[id].tsx:16 QR payload `kind: 'hectarehq_spray_signoff'` — external QR scanners see this string; internal identifier, arguable whether user-visible.
  d) /app/frontend/src/lib/migrate.ts:21 AsyncStorage marker key `@hectarehq/migrated-v1:*` — internal only, safe.
  e) /app/backend/routes/invitations.py:2 docstring + line 38 `APP_URL` default `https://hectarehq.app` — not user-facing (env-overridable), but should be updated for consistency.

NO regressions observed. No red screen. No pageerrors during runs.

ui_bugs.issue: Exported CSV filename still uses 'hectarehq-spray-records-...' — user-visible on download. Should be 'chaser-spray-records-YYYY-MM-DD.csv'.
Share summary header literal is 'HectareHQ Spray Record\n...' — user-visible on native Share sheet. Should read 'Chaser Spray Record'.

action_items: Replace 'HectareHQ' -> 'Chaser' in /app/frontend/src/lib/csv.ts:49 (filename) and /app/frontend/app/records/[id].tsx shareRecord() summary string.
Optional: update QR payload `kind: 'hectarehq_spray_signoff'` in records/[id].tsx:16 to 'chaser_spray_signoff' (only if you accept breaking any existing scanners); or leave for backward compat.
Optional: update /app/backend/routes/invitations.py docstring line 2 and default APP_URL line 38 to Chaser branding (or override APP_URL via env).

Optional: rename AsyncStorage marker `@hectarehq/migrated-v1` in src/lib/migrate.ts (BEWARE: existing users will be treated as unmigrated and may re-run migration on next login — recommend leaving as-is).
critical_code_review_comments: BUG FIXED by testing agent: /app/frontend/app/team.tsx used useRealtime() at line 38 but never imported it — every mount of the Team screen would ReferenceError under strict runtimes. Added the missing import. Please keep this in future refactors.
auth-context.tsx correctly re-subscribes to `businesses` UPDATE + `business_members` events per business id and force-signs-out a user whose membership row is deleted — solid multi-device UX.

realtime.ts guards on getBackendMode() !== 'cloud' and getActiveBusinessId() being null. Filter uses `business_id=eq.${businessId}`, which relies on all subscribed tables having a business_id column — verified all listed tables do.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of features under test — rebrand, invite email send + resend + backend log, realtime team propagation (~1.5s), rename business inline (owner) with persistence, owner-only pencil gating

seed_data_creation: Created 2 live Supabase owner accounts: hqowner<TS>@gmail.com (business 'Chaser Test Farm' → renamed to 'Chaser Test Farm Renamed', invited jake.comley@hotmail.com as operator, 2 emails sent), and hqrt<TS>@gmail.com (business 'Chaser RT Farm', invited hqrtinv<TS>@gmail.com used for realtime tab-B propagation test). Password 'Test1234!' on both.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Missing `import { useRealtime }` in team.tsx has been added — do NOT remove it. To repro realtime tests in playwright: open a second page in the SAME context (`ctx = page.context; pageB = await ctx.new_page()`) — Supabase session in localStorage is shared so pageB is already authenticated. Navigate both to /team, poll pageB's `[data-testid^="invite-row-"]` node count after sending an invite from pageA. Expect propagation < ~2s. Realtime subscription only activates once auth-context sets backend mode to 'cloud' (post-migration).
rca_of_issue: N/A — no functional bugs discovered besides the fixed missing import. Residual HectareHQ strings in csv.ts + records/[id].tsx shareRecord() are minor rebrand cleanup items and do not affect any listed test flow.
